_about: Atlas regions -> FlexConfig ROI, shared by tests/test_region_rois.py (tit.catalog.region_roi, which the agent's find_regions uses) and desktop/tests/unit/roi-region-table.test.ts (roiToConfig, the run pages' ROI picker), so the two constructions cannot drift. groundTruth: authored -- written from the AtlasROI / SubcorticalROI fields in contracts/generated/config.schema.json (one atlas_path and label per region; a cortical region read from its own hemisphere's .annot) and the catalog's Atlas/Region shapes, not produced by either implementation. tissues/space apply to volume atlases only (the picker's subcortical tissues and space; the agent's find_regions uses GM, in subject space for the subject's own atlases and MNI space for the shipped MNI volumes).

cases.why: volume atlas, both thalami: the atlas path once per label
packaged MNI volume, white and grey matter: tissues and space carried through
packaged MNI volume as find_regions offers it (GM, MNI space): both thalami of Harvard-Oxford subcortical, ids 4 and 15 from its shipped _LUT.txt
surface atlas, one region per hemisphere: each read from its own hemisphere's .annot (the catalog advertises the lh file)
surface region with no hemisphere: lh; only a leading 'lh.' of the file name is swapped (the 'lh.' inside 'sub-lh.' is a directory)
